description: We are AstroCoders, a passionate team making space science interactive and accessible. Combining web development (HTML/CSS/JS), Canva UI design, and NASA research, we built the "Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer." Our platform bridges theoretical science with hands-on STEM learning using reaction tests, equipment guides, and quizzes to inspire and train future space explorers.
summary: Astro World is an interactive, bilingual space exploration and mission control gateway designed for children ages 7–12, developed by team AstroCoders-EG.   What We Developed We built a web-based, full-stack platform featuring 3D cosmic scales (from the Observable Universe to planets), live NASA/CSA telescope imagery, and gamified Mission Control survival labs. The platform includes the "Ask Astro" bilingual AI science assistant, accessibility features like web speech narration and colorblind-safe gauges, and an achievement system utilizing Supabase and open APIs (such as APOD, DONKI, and OSDR).  How It Addresses the Challenge Astro World overcomes the limitation of passive, overwhelming space education by transforming dense NASA archives into hands-on survival planning and active scientific decision-making. Through interactive modules like habitat life-support balancing, radiation shield design, and space agriculture simulations, users learn core engineering and astrobiology trade-offs by experimenting directly.   Why It Is Important It bridges the gap between complex space science and young learners, fostering early STEM engagement through inclusive, multi-language, and gamified exploration.
details:
It offers an engaging website that helps children understand "Basic-to-Advanced" INFO which helps a child learn as well as be entertained by featuring real-time information and interactive scientific games .

The game offers a different approach to teaching with interactive website and it helps children understand the basic knowledge of space such as (Galaxies , systems , planets ....etc. ) and it offers and API system connected to the NASA information data base which helps a user find the data he would want to know in his journey .

We Intended to introduce the space field to children so we can build a generation that understands how to manage in space, so we can shift from real life challenges provided on the website to being a real astronauts or even benefiting your country in this amazing journey.

We used many coding languages such as : ( HTML , CSS , JS , SQL , REACT.JS )

We used : (Claude , Gemini ,Perplexity)

We used tools such as : Supabase2 , Antigravity , VS Code

Our project stands out creatively in so many ways :

- interactive 3D cosmic exploration :

instead of static textbook pages we offer a fully interactive 3D Solar System and milky way galaxy where users can click planets , zoom in , and inspect real-time metrics

- A personalized AI companion ("ASTRO") :

we offer voice narration , dialogue effects , dynamic 3D posses which gives the website an emotional engaging heartbeat that talks directly to users .

-Gamified Space Outpost Arcade : We transformed complex space science into fun, High-stakes mini games like meteor Dodger , Solar Storm Shield Builder , which allows kids to learn survival mechanics and orbital engineering through play .

-progression and reward system

The project keeps users hooked by implementing an astronaut ranking progression (from Junior Cadet to NASA Fleet Captain) along side space star economics .

The factors that our team considered are :

1-Teamworking

2-Efficent problem-Solving

3-Tasks assignment and managing

4-Constant work for hours

5-Mindfulness and ideation from scratch

6-Working under pressure
